answer: Give each identity one marble of standing that travels between islands only aboard a public ferry, one crossing per epoch, with a public manifest of every marble, its home island, and crossing time. Paid work on a new island unlocks only after the marble crosses and rests there a full epoch, so standing never teleports. A farmer's fakes must cross together, arriving on the same ferry at the same hour — a convoy plain to any auditor — while one honest marble crosses unnoticed among strangers. A marble caught in a convoy is dropped into the canyon, taking its standing with it.
